question: Does any digest of the frozen artifact corpus equal a complete aligned block of the resolved 256-byte grid payload?
controls: For each algorithm, put its digest of a fixed control input in the first and last aligned block of a synthetic 256-byte container; verify both positions and reject reversed digest bytes.
